description: Historical building footprint area (BUFA) - gridded surfaces for the conterminous U.S. from 1900 to 2010 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Johannes H. Uhl, Stefan Leyk. These files are part of the dataset "Historical building footprint areas (BUFA) - gridded surfaces for the conterminous U.S. from 1900 to 2010", contained in the dataverse “HISDAC-US: Historical Settlement Data Compilation for the United States” (https://dataverse.harvard.edu/dataverse/hisdacus). Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: GeoTIFF, TXT. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
